newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ACC shr down 13.5 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India's ACC shr down 13.5 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of India's largest cement maker Associated Cement Companies (ACC) slid 156 rupees or 13.5 percent to 1,000 rupees minutes after opening on the Bombay bourse, traders said.
They said speculators were hammering the stock after its first half net -- announced late on Tuesday -- fell sharply below market expectations

ACC said its net profit fell 56 percent to 550.5 million rupees in the first six months to September 30, 1996 against 1.25 billion rupees. ACC said it could not recover an unprecedented increase in input cost, affecting margins.
The results fell sharply below market expectations of a net profit of around 900 million rupees.
ACC shares fell sharply in off-market kerb deals after the results announcement.
